name: Delete account Email Sending suppression
description: Delete account Email Sending suppression Deletes the suppression, its note, and every legacy internal zone membership, allowing future delivery attempts to the address. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/suppressions/{suppression_id}

name: Delete account email suppression
description: Delete account email suppression Deletes an email suppression for the specified account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/suppression/{suppression_id}

name: Delete account email suppression
description: Delete account email suppression Deletes an email suppression for the specified account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/suppression/{suppression_id}

name: Create a destination address
description: Create a destination address Create a destination address to forward your emails to. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/addresses
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/addresses
Create a destination address to forward your emails to. Destination addresses need to be verified before they can be used.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete destination address
description: Delete destination address Deletes a specific destination address. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/addresses/{destination_address_identifier}

name: Get a destination address
description: Get a destination address Gets information for a specific destination email already created. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/addresses/{destination_address_identifier}

name: List destination addresses
description: List destination addresses Lists existing destination addresses. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/addresses
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/addresses
Lists existing destination addresses.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); direction (query); verified (query)

name: Update destination address
description: Update destination address Updates the status of a specific destination address. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/addresses/{destination_address_identifier}

name: List account routing rules
description: List account routing rules Lists existing routing rules across all zones in the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/rules
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/rules
Lists existing routing rules across all zones in the account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); enabled (query)

name: Plan account routing rule changes
description: Plan account routing rule changes Computes the Email Routing rule changes that would be needed to reconcile a Wrangler-managed desired ruleset. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/rules/plan
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/routing/rules/plan
Computes the Email Routing rule changes that would be needed to reconcile a Wrangler-managed desired ruleset. This endpoint is read-only and does not create, update, or delete rules.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Send an email
description: Send an email Send an email for the specified account using the structured builder. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/send
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/send
Send an email for the specified account using the structured builder. Provide the sender, recipients, subject, and at least one of text or html; attachments are optional.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifier of the account.; body (body)

name: Send a raw MIME email
description: Send a raw MIME email Send a raw RFC 5322 (MIME) email for the specified account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/send_raw
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/send_raw
Send a raw RFC 5322 (MIME) email for the specified account. Provide the full MIME message plus the SMTP envelope (from and recipients).
Required: account_id (path) — Identifier of the account.; body (body)

name: Fetch an email message
description: Fetch an email message Returns the raw RFC 5322 MIME message for the given account and message id. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/messages/{message_id}

name: Get account reputation
description: Get account reputation Returns the authoritative Email Sending reputation state and active evaluation policy. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/reputation
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/reputation
Returns the authoritative Email Sending reputation state and active evaluation policy. Accounts without an evaluation are Healthy with null evaluation timestamps.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Get sending limits
description: Get sending limits Returns the current daily sending quota for the account and, when a quota is resolved, the account's current usage against it. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/limits
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/email/sending/limits
Returns the current daily sending quota for the account and, when a quota is resolved, the account's current usage against it. Quota is null when not yet available; usage is null when there is no resolved quota or usage is temporarily unavailable.
Required: account_id (path)
